findings.title: CVE-2026-132231 (CVE Program record)
findings.summary_md: The indexed CVE Program entry for CVE-2026-132231 is timestamped 18 Nov 2026 17:07:48 UTC and credits JetBrains as the assigner. It describes remote code execution in TeamCity through best-fit character mapping in Perforce settings, affecting builds before 2026.1.3 and 2025.11.7. The entry predates the story's first event by roughly four hours.

findings.title: CVE-2026-132231 (NVD entry)
findings.summary_md: The indexed NVD entry for CVE-2026-132231 is timestamped 18 Nov 2026 17:17:44 UTC, about ten minutes after the CVE Program record. NVD gives the same affected-version boundary and the same mechanism, remote code execution via best-fit character mapping in Perforce settings. The record was already available before either event in this story.

findings.title: JetBrains security advisory (AV26-1176)
findings.summary_md: Defconlevel's copy of Cyber Centre advisory AV26-1176 is timestamped Nov 18, 2026 at 9:00 PM UTC, ten minutes before the story's first event. It lists TeamCity releases before 2025.11.7 and before 2026.1.3 as affected and points readers to JetBrains' fixed security issues page. The copy adds no independent analysis or exploitation reporting.
